whole_sign.giai_thich: Each 30-degree zodiac sign forms one full house starting from the Rising sign — the classical Hellenistic standard, clean at every latitude.

placidus.giai_thich: Time-trisected semi-diurnal/nocturnal house cusps; automatically falls back safely to Whole Sign at latitudes >= 66 degrees.

khong_gio_solar.giai_thich: Without a known birth hour, houses and Ascendant are omitted honestly while planetary signs and the Moon's 24-hour range are shown.

asc.bach_duong: Aries Rising: your natural doorway into new situations carries direct initiative, candid candor, and quick readiness to begin.
asc.kim_nguu: Taurus Rising: your natural doorway into new situations carries steady accumulation, tangible craft, and unhurried reliability.
asc.song_tu: Gemini Rising: your natural doorway into new situations carries curious inquiry, agile dialogue, and multi-threaded learning.
asc.cu_giai: Cancer Rising: your natural doorway into new situations carries protective care, emotional memory, and devotion to safe belonging.
asc.su_tu: Leo Rising: your natural doorway into new situations carries warm self-direction, generous presence, and wholehearted expression.
asc.xu_nu: Virgo Rising: your natural doorway into new situations carries discerning refinement, practical service, and clean organization.
asc.thien_binh: Libra Rising: your natural doorway into new situations carries fair-minded mediation, relational poise, and balanced proportion.
asc.bo_cap: Scorpio Rising: your natural doorway into new situations carries focused intensity, root-cause honesty, and deep loyalty.
asc.nhan_ma: Sagittarius Rising: your natural doorway into new situations carries broad horizon-seeking, candid synthesis, and love of exploration.
asc.ma_ket: Capricorn Rising: your natural doorway into new situations carries long-horizon discipline, structural accountability, and earned mastery.
asc.bao_binh: Aquarius Rising: your natural doorway into new situations carries independent systems thinking, principled reform, and civic perspective.
asc.song_ngu: Pisces Rising: your natural doorway into new situations carries receptive empathy, imaginative synthesis, and quiet compassion.
